prompt:
Use case: photorealistic visual learning assets for a children's Hanzi interactive playground; subject ID bell only.
Primary request: one vertical 1024x1792 photographic triptych containing exactly three separate landscape photographs stacked top to bottom, divided by two thin straight horizontal white seams, approximately 6 pixels thick. No outer border.
Top photograph: one complete small metal handbell with a wooden handle standing on a simple wooden tabletop, shown in three-quarter view. Its warm brass bell body, flared rim and complete wooden handle are clearly visible, with realistic subtle metal patina and wood grain.
Middle photograph: a small group of three complete hanging metal bells suspended by simple cords from a plain wooden horizontal support in a quiet garden setting. Each bell is clearly bell-shaped with a flared rim, not a tube or wind-chime rod. All three bells and their short suspension cords fit inside the frame; leafy garden background softly blurred, natural metallic reflections.
Bottom photograph: one complete medium-sized bronze bell mounted on a simple dark metal bracket attached to a plain wooden post in an outdoor courtyard. Show the full bell, flared opening, mounting bracket and short hanging pull rope, clearly centered and easy to recognize. Simple unmarked surroundings; no inscriptions on the metal or post.
Composition/framing: each panel is a standalone wide landscape photograph of equal height. Center each entire main object or bell group with at least 8 percent crop-safe empty margin on every side; complete handles, bell rims and short cords stay inside the frame. Use realistic gravity, mounting and metal construction; no clipped bells. Each panel must remain useful when independently cropped.
Style/medium: authentic photorealistic photography, natural detail, tactile metal patina and wood grain, credible proportions and reflections, no illustration, cartoon, CGI or toy-like rendering.
Lighting/mood: gentle natural daylight, believable soft shadows and true-to-life colors, calm and welcoming.
Constraints: exactly three panels in the specified order; exactly two thin white horizontal seams; no readable text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, brands, watermark, captions, decorative graphics or engraved writing; no people.
reviewNotes: Read-inspected the actual 1024x1792 PNG. Top: complete brass handbell with a turned wooden handle on a wooden tabletop, with natural metal patina, plant and chair in background. Middle: exactly three complete flared metal bells with visible clappers, suspended from a rustic wooden crossbar by short cords against leafy garden scenery. Bottom: complete patinated bell hung from a dark bracket on a wooden post, with clapper and fully visible short knotted pull rope in a courtyard. Bell bodies, handle and pull rope are uncropped; wooden support/post extend out of the scene. Natural light and plausible textures; no visible people, readable text, brands or watermarks. Pixel measurement found white seam rows 574–583 and 1119–1127; cuts 579 and 1123 are their rounded centers. Panels are not equal height; the handbell handle and bottom bracket/pull rope have less than the requested 8 percent vertical margin but remain clear of the prepare.cjs 8-pixel seam inset.
